**Visual analysis of test image:**
- Large central leaf shows diffuse interveinal chlorosis (yellowing between veins, veins remain somewhat green)
- Scattered small brown spots/lesions on the yellowing tissue
- Upper leaves showing more advanced yellowing and browning
- Overall pattern of yellow-green leaves with scattered necrotic spots

**Key matching:**
- The SDS reference (top-right panel) shows the same interveinal chlorosis pattern — yellow tissue between veins with brown necrotic patches surrounded by chlorotic areas
- The diffuse interveinal yellowing in the test image is the hallmark symptom: "scattered yellow diffuse spots between veins that expand to become brown lesions surrounded by chlorotic areas"
- Not Septoria (which is more angular discrete spots progressing from lower canopy with pycnidia)
- Not Brown Stem Rot (which requires stem pith discoloration as the key diagnostic)
- The overall leaf yellowing with interveinal necrosis pattern matches SDS well
